committee.sub: Morning brief · Friday 27 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Landing page test spend sits at $754.48 ex GST against 108 raw paid clicks, and creditRemainingExGst is now $0: the $600 credit is fully used, with zero review bookings (review_cta_click 0) and no confirmed qualified enquiry, so the pause-unless rule applies and matches ads.campaignStatus PAUSED.

No external Ads account changes fired in the last 24 hours or 7 days (externalLast24h 0, externalLast7d 0), so test numbers are not contaminated by outside edits; impression share is 10% with rank lost 68.6% against budget lost 21.8%, but budget stays fixed until the test concludes.

Since the test began, ask_cta_click (11) and quick_question_click (5) are carrying all the engagement on /free-workflow-review.html, while review_cta_click sits at 0: the short question form is doing the work the deeper Cal.com booking step still is not.

generate_lead has fired 3 times since the test started: each is only an unverified enquiry candidate that needs checking against the Formspree/Cal.com source email and grading against the real-business-plus-repeatable-admin-plus-named-system rule before it counts as qualified.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks have reached 108, well past the 75-click check point: confirm with the test log whether relevant clicks sit at 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, which would trigger the red flag.

The $600 promo credit is fully spent (creditRemainingExGst $0, spend $754.48 ex GST): apply the standing rule and keep paid search paused unless cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review.
Three generate_lead events have fired since the test started: check each against its Formspree/Cal.com source email and grade it in the test log against the qualified-enquiry rule.
Logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6 percent success: these need updating to match current site stats.

weekly: Landing page test wraps on spend:
the $600 credit is used up at 108 raw paid clicks and $754.48 ex GST, with zero review bookings logged, so paid search stays paused under the standing rule.
last7 sessions reached 18 against 17 the week before (up 6%), with visitors rising from 14 to 17.

leads.last7 held at 0, and the 3 unverified enquiry candidates logged since the landing page test began still need grading; only one genuine enquiry (23 Sept, before the test, traffic unverified) exists to date.

sessions rose from 5 to 9, the only trustworthy unpaid signal; LinkedIn picked up its first session since Chris resumed posting; AI Assistant traffic remained at zero (it undercounts, since untagged AI clicks can land in Direct, which held flat at 8).

269 impressions produced just 7 clicks through 24 Nov (Search Console lags, so this is not current), with the trade-focussed query 'ai automation for trades businesses' sitting at position 23 but still no clicks.
